asset.name: DataTable
asset.description: The controlled data presentation with sorting, filtering, pagination, selection, row actions, column visibility, responsive presentation modes, and server-side operation support.

requires.reason: Semantics, density, and overflow are shared.
Selection uses the shared model with stable identities across paging and reorder.
Loading, empty, partial, error, and offline presentation are delegated.

suggests.reason: Only collections with multi-item operations need it.
Column configuration matters for wide tables and is clutter for narrow ones.
Windowing is needed only above measured row counts.

rationale: Already implemented in the catalog at 1.2.0. The avoid constraint is the common defect: row actions revealed only on hover are unreachable on touch, and DESIGN.md forbids hover-only affordances outright.
